name: radix-shape-and-generic-lemmas-frozen
cmd: set -euo pipefail; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; status=0; bunx tsc -p lean-kernel/lift-simulation/tsconfig.json > "$OUT/types.log" 2>&1 || status=$?; bun test lean-kernel/lift-simulation/shape.test.ts > "$OUT/tests.log" 2>&1 || status=$?; bun lean-kernel/lift-simulation/check-lemmas.ts || status=$?; exit $status
